subject: Commercial close roadmap & billing logistics for TidePoint eval
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Barnes <rachel.barnes@tidepointhealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial close roadmap & billing logistics for TidePoint eval

Rachel —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I wanted to put a short commercial roadmap and billing checklist on paper so we can align upstream to procurement and finance. The goal is to close the evaluation and be ready to ramp in early January if all gates are met. High-level asks below; I can send a formal MAP/Milestone spreadsheet after we sync.

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Eval kickoff: data access & test corpus delivered (target: 2026-11-22)
- Mid-eval check: usage & quality review (target: 2026-12-08)
- Acceptance: QA pass + two acceptance prompts satisfied (target: 2026-12-20)
- Commercial commitment: signed SOW + PO (target: 2026-12-27)
- Ramp to committed capacity: staged by week, full ramp by 2027-01-15

Commercial / Billing items for procurement
- Proposed pricing schedule: 6-month ramp with commit-based discounting; detailed tiers to follow in SOW.
- Payment terms: Redwood default is Net30; we can discuss Net60 for healthcare customers with verified PO and an initial ramp commit.
- Invoicing cadence: monthly preferred; quarterly possible for enterprise finance teams (we can support either).
- Billing start date options (choose one):
  1) Billing starts on the PO effective date (preferred for finance alignment)
  2) Billing starts on production rollout (if PO cannot be issued until after acceptance)

Can you confirm who in procurement/finance we should loop in and whether TidePoint needs Net60 and quarterly invoicing? I will draft a clean SOW and a one-page MAP to attach.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Commercial close roadmap & billing logistics for TidePoint eval

Soojin —

Thanks for laying this out. Procurement is procurement@tidepointhealth.org (copied). A couple of notes from finance/procurement side:
- TidePoint prefers Net60 for new vendors in healthcare due to cash cycle timing — will that be acceptable for the first year?
- We prefer quarterly invoices for larger engagements; monthly invoicing is OK if Redwood needs it for cashflow.
- We need a completed vendor packet (W9 + supplier form) and a current SOC 2 report before a PO can be issued.

I'll introduce Ben Liu (CFO) once procurement has the SOW so he can review payment terms. We are aligned on the MAP timeline you proposed — data transfer should be ready Nov 22.

Regards,
Rachel Barnes

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Commercial close roadmap & billing logistics for TidePoint eval

Looping in a quick counter-proposal and protection items before we send SOW to procurement:

Commercial proposal (summary)
- Year 1 list price with evaluation discount: 10% off list during eval period; after PO/SOW sign we ladder to committed discounts based on annual token commit:
  - Commit >= $150k ARR: 12% discount
  - Commit >= $500k ARR: 18% discount
  - Commit >= $1M ARR: 25% discount
- Ramp schedule: 30% of commit first 30 days, 60% by day 60, 100% by day 90.

Payment terms & invoicing (our guidance)
- We can accept Net60 for healthcare where PO + vendor packet are provided before billing starts.
- If TidePoint requires billing start on production rollout rather than PO date, we need the PO within 30 days of rollout or pricing reverts to list for months where no PO is present.
- Invoicing cadence: monthly preferred; quarterly invoices OK but we need a signed SOW that references the PO number to avoid reconciliation gaps.

Other items to attach with SOW: SOC2 (current), Vendor W9, redacted SLA, sample invoice template. Rafael — please attach SOW v1 and SOC2 when you send.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Draft SOW & payment terms for TidePoint (v1)

Hi TidePoint procurement —

Attached is a clean SOW (Redwood_SOW_TidePoint_v1.pdf) and our SOC 2 Type II summary. Key commercial callouts are in Section 3 of the SOW: pricing table, commit discounts, and payment terms. A couple explicit asks to accelerate PO issuance:
- Please provide the PO number you will reference on invoices and confirm preferred invoice cadence (monthly vs quarterly).
- If TidePoint needs Net60 we can accept for Year 1 provided vendor packet is complete and PO is submitted within 30 days of the first invoice.
- Confirm desired billing-start: PO effective date OR production go-live. We recommend PO date for cleaner finance reconciliation.

We aim to align on a signed SOW + PO by 2026-12-27 to enable a Jan ramp.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Commercial Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Draft SOW & payment terms for TidePoint (v1)

Rafael / Soojin —

Thanks for the SOW and SOC2. Procurement has the following feedback:
- TidePoint requires Net60 on new vendor contracts; we will provide PO#45219 to reference on invoices.
- Our standard process is quarterly invoices for multi-line engagements; we will accept monthly invoices for settlement but prefer a single quarterly consolidated invoice for reporting.
- Please include a short clause in the SOW that billing will not start until a PO is issued unless both parties explicitly sign-off to bill on go-live.
- We need a vendor W9 and the Redwood remittance instructions to move forward.

Ben (cc) will confirm SLA tolerance levels; he asked for a brief note on data residency and KMS/HSM integrations if Redwood requires key management.

Procurement Team

Subject: Re: Draft SOW & payment terms for TidePoint (v1) — agreement on terms and next steps

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick summary and proposal to finalize:

Commercial concessions (proposed final)
- Redwood will accept Net60 for Year 1 on condition that:
  * PO#45219 (or an equivalent PO) is submitted within 30 days of the first invoice, and
  * vendor packet (W9 + supplier form) and SOC2 copy are in TidePoint possession before PO issuance.
- If TidePoint prepays annually, Redwood will offer an additional 2% prepay discount applied to year 1.
- If PO is delayed beyond 30 days from first invoice, January usage will be invoiced at list price until PO is validated; subsequent invoices will be reconciled.

Mutual Action Plan (finalized timeline)
- 2026-11-22: Data transfer complete / eval kickoff
- 2026-12-08: Mid-eval review (quality & performance)
- 2026-12-20: Acceptance confirmation (2 test prompts pass)
- 2026-12-27: SOW signed & PO submitted
- 2027-01-01: Billing start date (aligned to PO effective date)
- 2027-01-15: Full committed ramp target

Next steps
1) Rafael: upload final SOW v1 with the short billing clause and vendor remittance details (attached).
2) TidePoint procurement: issue PO#45219 and confirm invoice cadence (monthly statements to be aggregated quarterly for reporting).
3) Finance: exchange vendor packet (W9 + vendor form) and SOC2 receipt confirmation.

If this looks good I will route a DocuSign package for signature (SOW + MAP) and Rafael will send the final invoice template.

Thanks all — looking forward to closing this before year-end.

Soojin Lee | Account Executive
